title: HSK 3.1 · 把, 被, 发生, 人生, 总是
focus: 把 · 被 · 就是 · 时 · 需要 · 开始 · 并 · 所 · 死 · 种 · 希望 · 发生 · 为了 · 只是 · 世界 · 情况 · 比赛 · 继续 · 心 · 已 · 张 · 关系 · 总 · 只有 · 整个 · 极了 · 比较 · 个人 · 总是 · 除了 · 人员 · 生命 · 并且 · 发展 · 人生 · 人民 · 人类 · 紧张 · 类 · 产生
body:
The first HSK 3 lesson brings the two big grammar markers 把 and 被, plus a family of 人 words (个人, 人员, 人生, 人民, 人类) and 生 "be born, arise" words (发生, 生命, 产生).

## Characters that repeat

| Character | Pinyin | Meaning | In this lesson |
|---|---|---|---|
| 人 | rén | person | 个人, 人员, 人生, 人民, 人类 |
| 生 | shēng | be born, life, arise | 发生, 生命, 人生, 产生 |
| 发 | fā | send out, emit | 发生, 发展 |
| 是 | shì | be | 就是, 只是, 总是 |
| 只 | zhǐ | only | 只是, 只有 |
| 总 | zǒng | always, total | 总, 总是 |
| 并 | bìng | together; (not) at all | 并, 并且 |
| 比 | bǐ | compare | 比赛, 比较 |

## Watch out

- 已 yǐ (already) vs 己 jǐ (self) vs 巳 sì: open, half closed, fully closed.
- 种 has two readings: zhǒng "kind" (这种) and zhòng "to plant" (种树).
- 人生 is the life you live (your time on earth); 生命 is life as being alive.

cards.Example: 把门关上。 bǎ mén guānshang: close the door
cards.Notes: 扌 hand + 巴 bā for the sound = grasp. 把 X + verb: "take X and do": 把门关上 = take the door, shut it.

cards.Example: 我的车被偷了。 wǒ de chē bèi tōu le: my car was stolen
cards.Notes: 衤 clothing + 皮 pí for the sound = quilt; later "to suffer", hence the passive. 衤 (clothing) has two dots, 礻 (altar) one.

cards.Example: 就是他！ jiù shì tā: it's him!
cards.Notes: 就 right then, precisely + 是 be = "precisely is" → exactly that, it's just.

cards.Example: 小时候我很胖。 xiǎoshíhou wǒ hěn pàng: I was chubby as a kid
cards.Notes: 日 sun + 寸 (simplified from 寺 sì, sound) = time measured by the sun.

cards.Example: 你需要帮忙吗？ nǐ xūyào bāngmáng ma: do you need help?
cards.Notes: 需 need, require + 要 want = to need.

cards.Example: 电影开始了。 diànyǐng kāishǐ le: the movie has started
cards.Notes: 开 open + 始 beginning (女 + 台 for the sound) = open the beginning → start.

cards.Meaning: (before 不/没) not at all; and; side by side
cards.Example: 我并不知道。 wǒ bìng bù zhīdào: I really didn't know
cards.Notes: Originally two people side by side → combine, together. Before 不/没 it stresses "actually not, not at all".

cards.Example: 这所学校很大。 zhè suǒ xuéxiào hěn dà: this school is big
cards.Notes: 户 door + 斤 axe. Mostly in words: 所以 so, 所有 all, 厕所 toilet, 所 + verb = "that which".

cards.Example: 我饿死了！ wǒ è sǐ le: I'm starving!
cards.Notes: 歹 bare bones (death radical) + 匕 a kneeling person = death. After adjectives: "to death" (饿死了, 累死了).

cards.Example: 这种水果很甜。 zhè zhǒng shuǐguǒ hěn tián: this kind of fruit is sweet
cards.Notes: 禾 grain + 中 zhōng for the sound = seed → kind (zhǒng); to plant a seed (zhòng).

cards.Example: 希望你喜欢。 xīwàng nǐ xǐhuan: hope you like it
cards.Notes: 希 hope, rare + 望 gaze into the distance = gaze ahead hoping → hope.

cards.Example: 发生了什么事？ fāshēng le shénme shì: what happened?
cards.Notes: 发 send out, emit + 生 arise, be born = come out into being → happen.

cards.Example: 为了孩子，他很努力。 wèile háizi, tā hěn nǔlì: he works hard for his kids
cards.Notes: 为 wèi for the sake of + 了 = for, in order to. 为 is wéi in 认为, 成为.

cards.Example: 我只是问问。 wǒ zhǐshì wènwen: I'm just asking
cards.Notes: 只 only + 是 be = it's only… Also "but, it's just that".

cards.Example: 世界很大。 shìjiè hěn dà: the world is big
cards.Notes: 世 age, generation + 界 boundary, realm (田 field + 介 jiè for the sound) = world.

cards.Example: 现在情况怎么样？ xiànzài qíngkuàng zěnmeyàng: how are things now?
cards.Notes: 情 state, feeling (忄 heart + 青 qīng for the sound) + 况 condition = state of affairs.

cards.Example: 比赛几点开始？ bǐsài jǐ diǎn kāishǐ: what time does the match start?
cards.Notes: 比 compare + 赛 compete = compete, match.

cards.Example: 我们继续吧。 wǒmen jìxù ba: let's continue
cards.Notes: 继 carry on + 续 extend; both have 纟 silk = keep a thread going → continue.

cards.Example: 别担心。 bié dānxīn: don't worry
cards.Notes: Pictograph of a heart. As a part, 忄 (left) or 心 (bottom) marks feelings: 想, 情, 忙, 总.

cards.Example: 他已经走了。 tā yǐjīng zǒu le: he's already left
cards.Notes: Mostly in 已经. Lookalikes: 己 jǐ self (open), 已 yǐ already (half closed), 巳 sì (closed).

cards.Example: 给我一张纸。 gěi wǒ yì zhāng zhǐ: give me a sheet of paper
cards.Notes: 弓 bow + 长 cháng for the sound = draw a bow → stretch open; used for flat spread things: paper, tickets, tables.

cards.Example: 没关系。 méi guānxi: it doesn't matter
cards.Notes: 关 connect, concern + 系 tie = ties → relation. 没关系 = "no connection" → never mind.

cards.Example: 他总迟到。 tā zǒng chídào: he's always late
cards.Notes: 丷 + 口 + 心 heart. Means gather all → total (总共), always (总是), chief (总统).

cards.Example: 我只有十块钱。 wǒ zhǐ yǒu shí kuài qián: I only have ten kuai
cards.Notes: 只 only + 有 have. 只有…才… = only if… then.

cards.Example: 我睡了整个下午。 wǒ shuì le zhěnggè xiàwǔ: I slept the whole afternoon
cards.Notes: 整 whole, tidy (正 at the bottom, for the sound) + 个 unit = the whole thing.

cards.Example: 好吃极了！ hǎochī jí le: absolutely delicious!
cards.Notes: 极 extreme, pole (木 + 及 jí for the sound) + 了 = to the extreme. Comes after the adjective.

cards.Example: 今天比较冷。 jīntiān bǐjiào lěng: it's rather cold today
cards.Notes: 比 compare + 较 compare (车 + 交 jiāo for the sound) = compare → comparatively.

cards.Example: 这是我个人的意见。 zhè shì wǒ gèrén de yìjiàn: this is my personal opinion
cards.Notes: 个 single + 人 person = individual.

cards.Example: 你总是这样。 nǐ zǒngshì zhèyàng: you're always like this
cards.Notes: 总 always, all + 是 be = always.

cards.Example: 除了他，都来了。 chúle tā, dōu lái le: everyone came except him
cards.Notes: 除 remove (阝 + 余 for the sound) + 了 = having removed → except. 除了…还/也 = besides.

cards.Example: 工作人员在哪儿？ gōngzuò rényuán zài nǎr: where are the staff?
cards.Notes: 人 person + 员 member = personnel.

cards.Example: 生命很宝贵。 shēngmìng hěn bǎoguì: life is precious
cards.Notes: 生 live + 命 life, fate (口 mouth + 令 order) = life.

cards.Example: 他聪明并且努力。 tā cōngming bìngqiě nǔlì: he's smart and hardworking
cards.Notes: 并 together + 且 moreover = and furthermore. Joins verbs or adjectives, not nouns.

cards.Example: 这个城市发展很快。 zhège chéngshì fāzhǎn hěn kuài: this city is developing fast
cards.Notes: 发 send out + 展 unfold, spread = unfold outward → develop.

cards.Example: 人生很短。 rénshēng hěn duǎn: life is short
cards.Notes: 人 person + 生 life = a person's life. Compare 生命, life as being alive.

cards.Example: 为人民服务。 wèi rénmín fúwù: serve the people
cards.Notes: 人 person + 民 common people = the people of a nation. 民 also in 人民币 RMB.

cards.Example: 人类需要水。 rénlèi xūyào shuǐ: humans need water
cards.Notes: 人 human + 类 kind, category = humankind.

cards.Example: 别紧张。 bié jǐnzhāng: don't be nervous
cards.Notes: 紧 tight + 张 stretch = stretched tight → tense, nervous.

cards.Example: 我喜欢这类电影。 wǒ xǐhuan zhè lèi diànyǐng: I like this kind of film
cards.Notes: 米 rice on top + 大 big below. Means category: 人类 mankind, 种类 type.

cards.Example: 这会产生问题。 zhè huì chǎnshēng wèntí: this will cause problems
cards.Notes: 产 produce, give birth + 生 be born = come into being → arise, give rise to.
